measures.title: Replacement Capital Levy for Health, Safety and Energy Efficiency Improvements
measures.what_it_does: Replaces Dixie School District's capital levy, which expires at the end of 2026, with a six-year levy for 2027 through 2032 to keep funding health, safety and energy-efficiency repairs and modernization at Dixie School.
measures.cost_line: $75,000 a year for 2027 through 2032, an estimated $0.50 per $1,000 of assessed value.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Prescott Joint Park and Recreation District
measures.title: Maintenance & Operation Excess Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a one-year excess property tax levy for the park and recreation district's maintenance and operation expenses in 2027, its main source of operating money.
measures.cost_line: $175,000 collected in 2027, approximately $0.35 per $1,000 of assessed value.
